title: Adam and Eve Sin
lines: This is Adam and this is Eve, who were the first people on earth.
這是亞當，這是夏娃，他們是世上最早的人。
They lived in the Garden of Eden, which was a beautiful place that had everything they needed.
他們住在伊甸園，那是一個美麗的地方，凡他們所需要的都有。
Adam and Eve took care of the animals and could eat from any of the trees in the garden except for one.
亞當和夏娃照管動物，園中各樣樹上的果子他們都可以吃，只有一棵除外。
This was the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, and God told them not to eat from this tree.
那就是分別善惡的樹，神吩咐他們不可吃這棵樹的果子。
There were lots of animals in the garden, but the serpent was the most clever of all the wild animals God had made.
園中有許多動物，但在神所造的一切野獸中，蛇最狡猾。
One day he asked the woman, "Did God really say you must not eat the fruit from any of these trees in the garden?"
有一天，蛇問女人：「神豈是真說，不許你們吃園中所有樹上的果子嗎？」
Eve said that they were able to eat from all of the fruit trees except the fruit from the tree in the middle of the garden.
夏娃說，園中所有果樹的果子他們都可以吃，只有園子當中那棵樹的果子不行。
"For God said, 'You must not eat or even touch it. If you do, you will die.'"
「因為神曾說：『你們不可吃，也不可摸，免得你們死。』」
"God knows that as soon as you eat it, you will be like God, knowing both good and evil."
「因為神知道，你們吃的日子眼睛就明亮了，你們便如神能知道善惡。」
She saw that the tree was beautiful and its fruit looked delicious, and she wanted the wisdom it would give her.
她見那棵樹很美，果子看起來好吃，又想得著它能帶來的智慧。
So she took some of the fruit and ate it.
Then she gave some to Adam, and he ate it too.
At that moment their eyes were opened, and they suddenly realized they weren't wearing clothes and were embarrassed.
那一刻他們的眼睛就明亮了，忽然發現自己沒穿衣服，覺得很羞愧。
So they sewed fig leaves together to cover themselves.
於是他們用無花果樹的葉子編成裙子遮身。
When the cool evening breezes were blowing, Adam and Eve heard God walking about in the garden.
傍晚涼風吹起時，亞當和夏娃聽見神在園中行走的聲音。
So they hid from God among the trees.
他們就藏在園裡的樹木中，躲避神。
Then God called to Adam, "Where are you?"
神呼喚亞當說：「你在哪裡？」
Adam said, "I heard you walking in the garden, so I hid. I was afraid because I was naked."
亞當說：「我在園中聽見你的聲音，我就藏了。我害怕，因為我赤身露體。」
"Who told you that you were naked?" God asked.
神問：「誰告訴你赤身露體呢？」
"Did you eat from the tree I told you not to eat from?"
「莫非你吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那樹上的果子嗎？」
Adam said, "It was the woman you gave me who gave me the fruit, and I ate it."
亞當說：「你所賜給我、與我同居的女人，她把那樹上的果子給我，我就吃了。」
Then God asked Eve, "What have you done?"
神就問夏娃：「你做的是甚麼事呢？」
"The serpent tricked me," she replied. "That's why I ate it."
她回答：「那蛇引誘我，我就吃了。」
Then God punished the serpent by making it so he would crawl on his belly from then on.
神就懲罰那蛇，使牠從此用肚子行走。
He told Eve that she would have great pain in her life.
祂告訴夏娃，她一生將受許多苦楚。
Then God said to Adam that because he listened to Eve and did not obey what God had told him to do, his life would be very difficult.
神又對亞當說，因他聽了夏娃的話，沒有遵守神的吩咐，他的一生將十分艱難。
He would have to work hard to get food to eat.
他必須辛苦勞碌才得糊口。
God said, "For you were made from dust, and to dust you will return."
神說：「你本是塵土，仍要歸於塵土。」
Then God made them clothing from the animals.
神用動物的皮給他們做衣服。
But God knew that Adam and Eve could no longer live in the garden because of their sin.
但神知道，亞當和夏娃因為犯了罪，不能再住在園子裡。
So he sent them away and closed up the garden.
於是祂打發他們離開，把園子關閉了。
